name: Specialized
verdict: Specialized Bicycle Components is a private US company, founder-led; Taiwan's Merida holds an undisclosed minority share (since 2001). Nothing found.
note: US bike manufacturer; kit supplier of Red Bull-BORA-hansgrohe. Rating note (issue #603, 2026-09-29): private, founder-controlled, with a minority stake held by listed Taiwanese bike maker Merida — no control, no board role documented. No human-rights finding found.
